$comment: Claude Agent SDK MCP servers: `ClaudeAgentOptions(mcp_servers={"name": {"type": "http" | "sse", "url": ..., "headers": ...}})`. The app does not connect itself: the Claude Code process `query` / `ClaudeSDKClient` start does, with the configuration the app gives, so each HTTP server is still an outbound connection of the app, reported where the options name it. Servers with a `command` (stdio) or of type `sdk` (`create_sdk_mcp_server`, in process), and a path to a configuration file, are not reported. The model requests are `claude-agent-sdk.json`'s.
